interaction.edit_selection: Across the five rounds the model used physical and spatial diagnostics to choose the fields, regions, scales and magnitudes. Tools queried geometry, applied and saved the property arrays, and checked constraints. The specified candidates were evaluated directly, without an outer optimizer, gradients or a parameter sweep.
